description: SPEC §7D 'The §8 seams on an agent run': the agent runtime forwards `hooks` and `onMetric` verbatim into the client it builds for each handle, resolved def-over-runtime (replace, never merge). This is how §7F compaction reaches a §7E persona agent. Every port asserts these six scenarios; unset must stay byte-identical.

scenarios.name: runtime hooks reach an agent turn
scenarios.given: the runtime options carry hooks.beforeLLM, which appends a system message with content 'INJECTED-BY-HOOK'
scenarios.when: an agent handle runs one turn

expect.comment: the rewrite must reach the provider payload, not merely be observed

scenarios.name: runtime onMetric receives the §8 events
scenarios.when: an agent handle completes a turn

expect.comment: same event names and fields §8 specifies for a directly constructed client; the runtime adds, renames, drops, buffers, reorders and aggregates nothing

scenarios.name: a def's hooks REPLACE the runtime's, for that agent only
scenarios.given: the runtime sets a beforeLLM, agent A's def sets its own beforeLLM, agent B's def sets none
scenarios.when: A runs one turn, then B runs one turn

expect.comment: the runtime hook fires ONLY for B. Merging is non-conformant: composing two transcript rewrites has no defined order

scenarios.name: hooks and onMetric resolve independently
scenarios.given: the runtime sets both hooks and onMetric; agent A's def overrides hooks only

scenarios.name: a §7F compactor attached per-agent compacts an agent run

given.comment: seed the runtime's conversation store for the handle's id (conversation id = handle id) with 81 messages built deterministically, so every port produces the same bytes

expect.comment: the leading system prompt survives verbatim; the retained tail begins at a user turn (tool-pair safety, §7F)

scenarios.name: a compacted turn that suspends is rewound with the rest of the turn
scenarios.given: H5's seeded 81-message transcript and compactor, on an agent whose tool suspends under §10, with no waitFor interpreter anywhere in the chain
scenarios.when: the agent runs one turn and the turn parks durably

expect.comment: the stored transcript returns to its FULL pre-turn checkpoint and the compaction is discarded — the resumed replay compacts again. A port that persists the compacted head across a suspension is non-conformant.

invariants.unsetIsByteIdentical: with neither hooks nor onMetric set at either level, a run's wire transcript, stored transcript, transition trace and result are byte-identical to a runtime without the fields. Ports SHOULD pin this against output recorded BEFORE the capability existed, not against their own current output.
invariants.forwardedNotInterpreted: the runtime does not compose, wrap, reorder, default or read either value
invariants.runtimeInvariantsUntouchable: neither value can alter the handle's composed soul (systemPrompt), its §10 escalating waitFor, its turn-gated HTTP seam, or the runtime-wide conversation store
invariants.cloneParity: ports whose def/options are rebuilt field-by-field (java withBudget + copyWithRegistry, csharp CloneWith + CloneWithRegistry) MUST carry both fields through every such clone — a missed field is a silent per-spawn or per-subtree drop
